author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices skip-a-key fingers, silent beats, shifted patterns, three Cs across the keyboard, counting in threes and interlocking hands, with Strauss's river waltz.

classes.title: Skip-a-key: 1, 3, 5
classes.goal: Place the thumb on C and climb C, E, G with fingers 1, 3 and 5.

mathTarget.parentLine: Play one key, skip one, play the next

classes.parentPrompt: Help your child rest the thumb on C, then touch C, E, G, skipping a key each time.
classes.childAction: Thumb on C. Climb C, E, G with fingers 1, 3, 5.
classes.bridge: C, E, G are stepping stones across the river, one stone skipped each time.

intro.caption: Three stones across the river
intro.parentCue: thumb on C, just left of the two black keys

games.caption: C, C, E, G: up the stones

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: skipping keys with fingers 1, 3 and 5.

classes.title: Shh, then ta-ta
classes.goal: Learn the high answer and feel the silent beat before each ta-ta.

mathTarget.parentLine: The beat keeps going, even when no note plays

classes.parentPrompt: Whisper 'shh' on the silent beat and say 'ta-ta' on the two notes after it.
classes.childAction: Shh on one, then play ta-ta up high. Shh, ta-ta!
classes.bridge: The silent beat is a dancer's spin; ta-ta are two steps landing up high.

intro.caption: Shh, ta-ta. Shh, ta-ta.
intro.parentCue: whisper shh on the silent beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping the beat through a silent beat.

classes.title: Same shape, one key lower
classes.goal: Learn part three: the same climbing shape, moved one key lower.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same climbing shape, starting one key lower

classes.parentPrompt: Help your child start one key lower, thumb on B; the hand hops up for A.
classes.childAction: Thumb on B, one key lower. Climb the same shape again.
classes.bridge: The river bends: the same stones, one step to the left.

intro.caption: The river moves one step
intro.parentCue: slide the hand one key left, thumb on B

games.caption: One key lower: B, B, D, A
games.parentCue: Say 'same shape, lower' as your child plays

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: the same shape, moved lower.

classes.title: Three Cs on the river
classes.goal: Play the whole waltz slowly and find the three Cs the climb reaches.

mathTarget.parentLine: C lives in many houses: low, middle and high

classes.parentPrompt: Point to each C before the climb: this C, the next C, the high C.
classes.childAction: Play slowly and point to each C the climb reaches.
classes.bridge: Each C is the same house on the river; the high one is far right.

intro.caption: Find three Cs, low to high
intro.parentCue: point to three Cs, left to right

games.caption: Three Cs: same name
games.parentCue: Point to each C as it lights

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: the same note in three places.

classes.title: Oom-pah-pah, low on one
classes.goal: Play one low left-hand note on one of each bar of three.

mathTarget.parentLine: A waltz counts in threes: One, two, three

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune and say 'oom, pah, pah' out loud; your child plays on oom.
classes.childAction: Left hand plays one low note on every oom.
classes.bridge: The low note is the dancer's big step; pah, pah are two little twirls.

intro.caption: Oom, pah, pah
intro.parentCue: say it together, sway on oom

games.caption: Find the low notes
games.parentCue: Point to each low key first

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting in threes, landing on one.

classes.title: Left fills the gap
classes.goal: Play both hands slowly: the left hand plays where the right hand rests.

mathTarget.parentLine: Left hand plays in the gap where the right hand rests

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'left' on one and 'right, right' on two, three. Go very slowly.
classes.childAction: Left on one, right on two, three. Hands take turns.
classes.bridge: Two dancers take turns: the left one steps, then the right one twirls.

intro.caption: Two hands take turns
intro.parentCue: say left, right, right, very slowly

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: two hands taking turns in one tune.

classes.title: Waltz with the orchestra
classes.goal: Play the waltz along with the music at full speed and keep going.

mathTarget.parentLine: Fitting your playing to a speed you did not choose

classes.parentPrompt: Sway 'oom, pah, pah' beside your child; if notes are missed, keep going and smile.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music. Missed notes? Keep dancing!
classes.bridge: Strauss first wrote this for a choir, then for a whole orchestra.

intro.caption: The orchestra is waltzing!
intro.parentCue: sway beside your child with the music

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping up with the music.

classes.title: Waltz home to C
classes.goal: Play the whole waltz for teddy and hear it end on the C where it began.

mathTarget.parentLine: The waltz begins on C and comes back to the same C

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; point to the first C before you start and at the end.
classes.childAction: Play to the end, land on the first C, and take a bow.
classes.bridge: The river flows far away and high, then carries you home to C.

intro.caption: A waltz for teddy!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a whole song that returns to its start.
